|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]] (version 3 of 3). It is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]]): the card image at official release (1 October 2023)<ref name="ht-2494181">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/kylomasteroftheknightsofren.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Dark/large/kylomasteroftheknightsofren.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de 2494181] “Set 22”, 1 October 2023.</ref> prints: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While in battle alone: your total power here is +3, battle destiny draws may not be added and, if defending, once per game may take an Interrupt (except Ghhhk) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if alone).”<ref name="cj-867258b">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/867258b swccg-card-json commit 867258b] “Set 22” (1 October 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 6 October 2023: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While in battle alone: your total power here is +3, battle destiny draws may not be added and, if defending, once per game may take an Interrupt (except Ghhhk) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if alone).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (12 December 2025, with the PC's December 2025 image updates)<ref name="ht-ffcb1fc">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ffcb1fce6685bcc5eab07991cfdfa4d9d070c9c8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/kylomasteroftheknightsofren.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Dark/large/kylomasteroftheknightsofren.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ffcb1fce6685bcc5eab07991cfdfa4d9d070c9c8 ffcb1fc] “First Order Icon”, 12 December 2025, with the PC's December 2025 image updates.</ref> prints: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While in battle alone: your total power here is +3, battle destiny draws may not be added and, if defending, once per game may take an Interrupt (except Ghhhk) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if alone).” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The round faction icon at top left was redrawn (the first image shows a solid ring, the re-made image thin red spokes). No errata mark. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
